entities.name: F4JRC5 PAMP peptide 2
observations: Reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana protein with an exact 84-residue sequence match to the query (100% identity and coverage; E-value 2.31e-54).
N-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with secretion; annotated to the apoplast and extracellular space.
Acts as an endogenous elicitor and positive regulator of plant defense, amplifying flg22-triggered immune responses.
Negatively regulates root growth and is associated with auxin response and response to bacterium.

entities.name: Arabidopsis innate immune response
observations: F4JRC5 PAMP-induced secreted peptide 2 participates in innate immune response and amplifies flagellin (flg22)-triggered defense signaling.

entities.name: Root growth regulation
observations: F4JRC5 is annotated as a negative regulator of root growth and is associated with regulation of root development.
